H.text_or_description: 3 Days of DRESS Deals FINAL DAY!

clean.rationale_short: The headline '3 Days of DRESS Deals FINAL DAY!' is prominent and immediately communicates the urgency and offer. The product (two women in dresses) is visually central and reinforces the offer. The call-to-action 'SHOP NOW' is clearly placed at the bottom for easy access. The hierarchy prioritizes the offer, then the product, then the action.
